prayerExcerpt.en-US: The flock of the faithful may always find shepherds after your own heart.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Que o rebanho dos fiéis encontre sempre alimento em verdes pastagens e pastores segundo vosso coração.

meta.face: A man of about forty-five, clean-shaven, with a long, smooth, egg-shaped face narrowing evenly to a rounded chin — a long, fine, straight nose, dark almond-shaped eyes under thin, high-arched brows, smooth cheeks with little modelling, a small, firm mouth with a full lower lip; short dark-brown hair cut round the head with a broad clerical tonsure on the crown, and a calm, noble, slightly reserved look.
meta.basis: Follows the Flemish Baroque tradition, as in Gaspar de Crayer's 1664 Norbert: a clean-shaven, oval-faced canon with short dark hair in the white habit, with the monstrance and the double-barred cross of the archbishop of Magdeburg. He was archbishop from his mid-forties and died at about fifty-four.
